requests.summary: Duel Flip's free panel scores are done (10 tables, 1,600 games per persona). Predicted fun: casual 4.05, competitor 4.02, strategist 3.85, family 3.62, story 3.56. Next step is five in-character AI reviews (Haiku, one per persona).
requests.why_needed: The scores are numbers only. The reviews add the 'why': best and worst moments, real frustrations, who each persona enjoyed playing with. Task 006 asks for them as the first full test of the panel.
requests.expected_outcome: Five review files in games/duelflip/panel/, a panel-report.md, and reviews that read like five different people, each naming a real frustration.

options.label: Run the five persona reviews (Haiku, one at a time) and write the panel report
Skip the reviews; keep only the free scores

requests.summary: Task 009 wants to test one free API (OpenRouter free models or Google AI Studio) for persona reviews. That means sending Duel Flip's rules and persona material to a third party.
requests.why_needed: Local Ollama on your Mac needs no approval, but a free API could be faster on a small Mac. Free tiers may use prompts for training, so unpublished designs should only go there with your agreement. I could not read the providers' terms from this cloud session, so I cannot summarise them yet.
requests.expected_outcome: A blind quality comparison against Haiku and a recommendation per job. If you decline, the experiment uses local Ollama only.

options.label: Allow one free API for the experiment (after I summarise its data-use terms)
Local Ollama only; send nothing to third parties

requests.owner_notes: Owner: test on my Mac (local Ollama only)

requests.summary: The idea bank has only 2 banked ideas scoring 18 or more (needs 3) and the last scan was 2026-10-03 on a single game, so starting a new game needs a market scan first.

requests.expected_outcome: At least 5 new scored ideas in research/idea-bank.json, so the next game can start from a brief (target: 3 or more banked ideas scoring 18+).
